summary.text: Roger Albert is a Republican member of the Maine House of Representatives for District 2 and is a candidate for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Albert has represented District 2 since 2022 and lives in Madawaska.

paragraphs.text: Roger Albert lives in Madawaska, Maine, and served in the Maine National Guard.
He won District 2 in 2022, succeeding Michele Meyer, and won re-election in 2024, defeating Roland Martin.
Ballotpedia lists his 2023-2024 committee assignment as the Transportation Committee.
Martin is again his Democratic opponent in the 2026 general election.
